name: ANNALY CAPITAL MANAGEMENT INC
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-12), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (p. F-6): the investing-activities section lists only payments/proceeds on securities, loans, MSR and interests in MSR, reverse repurchase agreements and JV distributions for FY2025, FY2024 and FY2023 — there is no purchases-of-property-and-equipment (or any PPE capex) line in any of the three years, and the balance sheet carries no property-and-equipment line (engine ppe_net is blank for every year). The statement fully reconciles without one (dollars in thousands): FY2025 operating 692,911 + investing (27,362,734) + financing 27,219,634 = the reported net increase in cash 549,811 exactly; FY2024: 3,310,659 - 14,984,830 + 11,750,050 = reported 75,879 exactly; FY2023: 2,367,203 - 8,415,890 + 5,884,121 = reported (164,566) exactly. EDGAR companyfacts for CIK 1043219 contains no PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment fact in any year.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under every candidate tag the engine reads because Annaly, a mortgage REIT holding financial assets, buys no property or equipment and reports no capex line; the filer's own cash-flow statements fully account for investing activities in all three years, so PPE capex is $0 as a filing fact, not an estimate (same treatment as the EG/RGLD/DFTX precedents in this sweep). Measured impact is nil: the engine's history already carried capex as assumed-zero, so the override changes no OE figure — it converts a silent zero-fill into a sourced, registered decision.

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-12), Note 14 Long-Term Stock Incentive Plan (p. F-30): 'The Company recognized equity-based compensation expense of $28.0 million for the year ended December 31, 2025.' The same note in the FY2024 10-K reports $23.2 million for FY2024 and in the FY2023 10-K $17.3 million for FY2023 — EDGAR companyfacts carries no ShareBasedCompensation annual fact for 2023-2025 (the tag was last filed for FY2009), so the expense is disclosed only in this note.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under every tag the engine reads; the filer's own 10-K Note 14 discloses the equity-based compensation expense for each year ($17.3M / $23.2M / $28.0M). A single override value fills every untagged year, so the latest filed year (FY2025, $28.0M) is used for all years: it overstates FY2024 and FY2023, i.e. it errs in the conservative direction (more SBC = lower owner's earnings), and the amount is immaterial either way — $28M is ~$0.04/share against a normalized OE base of several dollars per share (under ~1% of the base in each gated year).

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 15.9%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md

CASH_INCLUDES_RESTRICTED: the only cash tag filed for the latest fiscal year is the combined cash + restricted-cash total and no restricted-cash tag separates it — net debt is UNDERSTATED by the restricted amount (escrow / collateral / regulatory); check the balance sheet before trusting HIGH_NET_DEBT's absence
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Real Estate sector — OE/capex DCF fits real estate names poorly; grade confidence low
